record.question: In November 2025, India imposed a 30% import duty on which agricultural commodity?
record.explanation: Answer C: Yellow Peas. The Gazette of India Notification 46/2025-Customs specified yellow peas (tariff item 0713 10 10) and effective date 1 November 2025. Reference: https://egazette.gov.in/WriteReadData/2025/267254.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
